Rules.InvariantScript:
With(
    { p: Value(Substitute(ThisItem.PctGlobal, ".", ",")) },
    If(
        p < 0.25, Color.Red,
        p < 0.5, Color.Orange,
        p < 0.75, Color.Yellow,
        p < 0.89, Color.Green,
        Color.Gray
    )
)
